Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_abo VARCHAR2(4);
 temp_desc VARCHAR2(20);
begin
 if :s_abo_desc is not null
 then
 parse_abo('M', temp_abo, temp_desc);
 BEGIN
 SELECT 'x'
 INTO :GLOBAL.x
 FROM vserv_abo
 WHERE identifier_code = 'RG'
 AND rownum < 2
 AND exists ( SELECT 'x'
 FROM set_inventory_levels
 WHERE blood_type = temp_abo
 AND chapter_id = :s_chapter_id)

procedure check_antigens (p_antigen in VARCHAR2) is

ProgramUnit.Name: QUERY_ACTIVE_TABLE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure query_active_table is
 antigen_string VARCHAR2(300);
 antigens VARCHAR2(300);
 ant_fld VARCHAR2(10);
 rsl_fld VARCHAR2(9);
 ant_enter number := 0;
 ant_found number := 0;
 string_found number := 0;
 temp_unit_count number := 0;
 v_local_time timestamp;
 --
 -- this cursor is used to get all unit with the same product
 -- type, [blood type], and inventory class.
 --
 cursor avail_unit is
 select unit_id, coll_date, product_code, blood_type,
 aliquot, exp_date, warehouse_id
 from active_products
 where product_type = :ctrl_blk.product_type
--Following subquery added to get all possible abo label having blood type with tested abo code
-- same as that of selected blood type in control block 
 and blood_type in ( SELECT distinct abo_label
 FROM valid_abo_values
 WHERE (tested_abo_code,abo_only)
 in ( SELECT tested_abo_code,abo_only
 FROM valid_abo_values
 WHERE abo_label = nvl(:ctrl_blk.s_abo_code,blood_type)
 AND identifier_code = 'RG' ) )
 and inventory_class = nvl(:ctrl_blk.inv_class, inventory_class)
 and chapter_id = :s_chapter_id
 and stock_state = 'AV'
 and warehouse_id = nvl(:ctrl_blk.wh_id, warehouse_id)
 order by warehouse_id, unit_id;
 --
 -- this cursor is used to make a concatenated string
 -- of the unit antigen test and their results for only
 -- those tests in the current unit
 --
 cursor unit_ant (pcur_unit_id in varchar2,
 pcur_coll_date in date) is
 select distinct test_id||'-'||test_result||':' test_string
 from unit_antigens
 where unit_id = pcur_unit_id
 and coll_date = pcur_coll_date
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and test_id != 'ABORH';
begin
 go_block('active_info');
 for avl_rec in avail_unit
 loop
 antigen_string := ':';
 for unit_rec in unit_ant (avl_rec.unit_id, avl_rec.coll_date)
 loop
 antigen_string := antigen_string || unit_rec.test_string;
 end loop;
 ant_enter := 0;
 ant_found := 0;
 for I in 1..14 loop
 ant_fld := 'ANTIGEN_'|| to_char(I);
 rsl_fld := 'RESULT_' || to_char(I);
 if name_in(ant_fld) is not null
 then
 ant_enter := ant_enter + 1;
 antigens := ':'||name_in(ant_fld)||'-'||name_in(rsl_fld)||':';
 string_found := instr(antigen_string,antigens);
 if string_found > 0
 then
 ant_found := ant_found + 1;
 end if;
 end if;
 end loop;
 if ant_found = ant_enter
 then -- Found a unit with matching antigens
 :unit_id := avl_rec.unit_id;
 :coll_date := avl_rec.coll_date;
--chk_digit_query returns the check digit of the unit ID 
 :chk_digit := chk_digit_query(avl_rec.unit_id,avl_rec.coll_date,:GLOBAL.chapter_id);
 :product_code := avl_rec.product_code;
 :blood_type := avl_rec.blood_type;
 :aliquot := avl_rec.aliquot;
 :exp_date := avl_rec.exp_date;
 :warehouse_id := avl_rec.warehouse_id;
 --
 temp_unit_count := temp_unit_count + 1;

 --
 -- Get abo description
 --
 begin
--Modified for both schemes to coexist
 select abo_desc
 into :s_blood_type_desc
 from vserv_abo
 where abo_code = :blood_type
 AND unit_scheme_type = decode(:chk_digit,NULL,'C','I')
 and sysdate between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date,sysdate);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 null;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 down;
 end if;
 end loop;
 clear_record;
 first_record;
 if :active_info.unit_id is null
 then
 show_error_dist('2101');
 go_block('ctrl_blk');
 else
 :s_unit_count := temp_unit_count;
 :s_pointer := '>';
 --go_query('antigen_info');
 go_block('antigen_info');
 clear_block;
 populate_antigens (:active_info.unit_id);
 go_block('active_info');
 end if;

ProgramUnit.Name: POPULATE_ANTIGENS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE populate_antigens (p_unit_id in varchar2) IS
 cursor unt_antigen is select unit_id, test_id, test_result from unit_antigens where unit_id=p_unit_id and test_id!='ABORH';
 c_status varchar2(1);

BEGIN
 first_record;
 for Z in unt_antigen loop
 :antigen_info.test_id:=z.test_id;
 :antigen_info.test_result:=z.test_result;
 begin
 select confirm_status into c_status from ag_donor_tests_det where
 donor_id=(select donor_id from donations where unit_id=p_unit_id) and nvl(confirm_status,' ')='Y' and test_id=z.test_id and rownum=1;
 :antigen_info.confirm_flag:=c_status;
 Exception when others then 
 null;
 End;
 
 next_record;
 end loop;
END;
